content: An'kab a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl
Atɔŋ, mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làkäl anà ngyööb ntɔn ndaa iler indiir a Dweelà.
Bɛ làkyàyöb naa umpal làkäl bɛ baar mpa abà Ayudà, bàlasyeenà ukɔɔn ayöb, ntsü akà bànzam a itɛk abà nkiin.

Kyakin mɛ alàkyään naa: akà mbuur mwɛy tɛy awà kan'kwo mutɛn u mbwo a Dweelà a Nzam naa: « Wɛy Yɛsu ukäl wàŋàküül! » Mbuur mwɛy tɛy kan'kwo mutɛn naa: « Mwol Yɛsu! », isàkɔɔn akal Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
An'kab a kab a ngway mà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Dweelà nsil wa.
Isal byà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Mwol nsil wa.
Nsyääl yà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Nzam nsil wa afàkyer indiir byanswà amu baar banswà.
Amu mbuur mbuur Dweelà afàmɛnà u mbwo a kab ntɔn ubwaŋ a baar banswà.
Dweelà afàpà akà mbuur umwɛy ndaa a an'yeerà, akà wumwɛy, Dweelà nsil awà afàpà ndaa a ngyööb,
Dweelà mwɛy nsil awà afàpà akà umwɛy làkwikilà, akà wumwɛy ikɔ̈b mukɔɔr aŋukyal.
Dweelà afàpà ngwal akà umwɛy mukyer impà, akà wumwɛy kab mutà ngɔɔm, akà wumwɛy musà nsɔ̈ɔ̈l unsà an'dweelà, akà wumwɛy mutɛn ndaa a ifà ifà, akà wumwɛy ntɔn mubaal ndaa ya.
Dweelà nsil mwɛy awà mpɛl afàkyer indiir abin byanswà, mupà akà mbuur mbuur kab a nsöön, asànaa ukwen nde.
Ndür mwɛy, itiir mbɔɔn
Ndür yà mwɛy, itàkal naa itiir byà mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ itiir a ndür byanswà, itàkal naa bya byà mbɔɔn, bya ikyerà ndür mwɛy mpɛl. Abà, ya sye yà asànaa Klistɔ.
Ntɔn, bi banswà kàwɛl ndüümà unsà Dweelà mwɛy mpɛl amu ndür mwɛy mpɛl, itàkal Ayudà itàkal Angɛlɛki, asɔ itàkal baar a nsaay, bi banswà kànü unsà Dweelà mwɛy awunà.
Abun, ndür kà yàŋàkyer anki itiir mwɛy mpɛl, wɛɛ yà itiir mbɔɔn.
Isàkal naa làkɔl lan'tɛn naa: « Asànaa mɛ kà in'wà kɔɔ anki, mɛ uboo a ndür watɛy », nkye la làkyer ayàlwomà mukal itiir a ndür?
Isàkal naa tsü lan'tɛn naa: « Asànaa mɛ kà dii anki, mɛ kà in'wà uboo a ndür anki », nkye la làkyer ayàlwomà mukal itiir a ndür?
Yàlàkal naa ndür yanswà ikäl dii, ngweem ilàkal ken? Yàlàkal naa ya yanswà ikäl tsü, usɔŋ bàliweemà ken?
Wɛɛ Nzam kàsi itiir itiir unsà ndür, asànaa kàkwen nde.
Yàlàkal naa byanswà ikäl itiir mwɛy mpɛl, ndür yàlàkal ken?
Apà, itiir byà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ ndür yà mwɛy mpɛl.
Dii taaŋ atɛn tɛy a kɔɔ naa: « Mɛ mfun a ngye yatɛy », itàkal un'tswe utɛn a in'kɔl naa: « Mɛ mfun abɛ yatɛy. »
Kyekà, itàkal itiir a ndür ifàmɛnà naa bya byà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, bya byà mfun,
abyà ifàman bi naa ndöŋ a mbɔɔn byatɛy u ndür, akà bya bi ifàpà nsyäŋà aŋàsöönà. Abyà ifàman bi naa bya ntwɛn yatɛy, bi bya ifàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ubwaŋàbwaŋ,
kyekà, itiir abye anà ntwɛn, byàfàkal anki anà mfun mulɔɔn bya. Wɛɛ Nzam ndür kàboom naa nsyäŋà mbɔɔn ikäl akà itiir abyà ifàmɛnà naa bya ndöŋ byatɛy:
ntɔn nkaabà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akal u ndür, wɛɛ itiir byanswà ikäl ngyal mwɛy bamwɛy anà bumwɛy.
Isàkal naa itiir imwɛy kyà anà usaay, itiir byanswà byan'kab usaay aban. Isàkal naa itiir imwɛy bàmusyäŋà, itiir byanswà byan'saŋ anà nde.
Kyekà, bɛ làbà ndür a Klistɔ, umwɛy umwɛy wà itiir a ndür ande.
Kyakin, uboo a Ikööŋ, Nzam kàsi bàtàtwɛb antööm, bàyweel aŋangɔɔm, bàtär alɔɔŋ, ungö apan, kab a impà, kab a nkɔɔr, là mbaay, là ntwasà, anà kab mutɛn ndaa a ifà ifà.
Nkye ba banswà bà antööm? Nkye ba banswà bà aŋangɔɔm? Nkye ba banswà bàkyer afàlɔŋ? Nkye ba banswà bàfàkyer impà?
Nkye ba banswà bye anà kab a nkɔɔr? Nkye ba banswà bàfàtɛn ndaa a ifà ifà? Nkye ba banswà bàfàbaal ndaa?
Abun, làkäl anà ngyal a ngwal yan'kab masöönà ndöŋ. Ungö apan, mɛ in'yàlaswaŋ mbwo yan'söön ubwaŋ.
